{"path":"AGENTS.md","content":"# Agent instructions for oscraft

Comments are not kept in source: durable facts live here and names carry intent. Rule provenance that annotated Lua before the comment sweep is in git history (`git log --diff-filter=M -S'F_V 14297' -- scenarios/moba/kill_gold.lua`).

## Invariants

- **6.88g takes precedence over every other source.** A 6.88g value is used as is. When silent: analyze (our data, map files and script), then web (Dota Allstars 6.88 changelogs and wiki, map dumps, wc3 modding docs, openwar3), then a guess. Every value carries one final label in the file that holds it: `6.88g`, `web` or `GUESS`, with its source (war3map.j line, URL, or the guess's reasoning). A hero absent from 6.88g takes its Dota 2 entry as `GUESS(web)`. UNVERIFIED is not a final label; an unverified value is a `kind=unverified` provenance row.
- **ENGINE_DEFAULT is the Custom ruleset** (6.88g w3i game_data_setting=0): a value 6.88g leaves to the engine takes the Custom value, not Melee.
- Generator output is never hand-edited: edit the generator.

## Build, CI, Pages, dev loop

{"path":"README.md","content":"# oscraft

A deterministic, generic game engine: a pack of data and Lua defines the game, played in the browser. The simulation is Rust (native and wasm), the game is data (`.osd` text compiled to a binary image), and mods are Lua 5.4. The same inputs give the same state hash on every platform.

## What it is

- A fixed-point simulation (`rust/crates/sim`) with combat, pathfinding, attributed units, ability ranks, items, shops, camps and status effects.
- A pack model: each scenario directory holds `.osd` data, Lua mods and a `manifest.json`; the engine has no built-in game types. `scenarios/moba` is one example pack (a 5v5 match of units, items and rules) and `scenarios/duel-routes` is a routes test.
- A static browser client in `js/client` (GitHub Pages target), buildless: committed ES modules and wasm, peers joined over WebRTC and Nostr.

## Run

The packs are built and checked from `rust/`:

```
cd rust
cargo test --workspace
cargo run -p mapexport -- ../scenarios/moba ../scenarios/moba/moba.osdt
```

The browser game is the static page in `js/client/`. Build its wasm into `js/client/pkg` with `wasm-pack build crates/web --target web --out-dir ../js/client/pkg`, serve the repository root (for example `python3 -m http.server`), and open `js/client/play.html#moba`. For mods and map editing see [docs/QUICKSTART.md](docs/QUICKSTART.md).

## Docs

- [docs/QUICKSTART.md](docs/QUICKSTART.md): build, serve, play, mod, edit a map
- [docs/GAME.md](docs/GAME.md): how a match plays, with numbers and which are UNVERIFIED
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): crates, data format, sim, browser host, wasm, client, wire, mod host
- [docs/REFERENCE.md](docs/REFERENCE.md): every hero, ability, item and unit (generated by `node scenarios/moba/tools/gen-reference.mjs`)
- [docs/MODDING.md](docs/MODDING.md), [docs/SCENARIOS.md](docs/SCENARIOS.md), [docs/HOST.md](docs/HOST.md), [docs/WIRE.md](docs/WIRE.md)

## Browser client

The playable build is a static page in `js/client/`, the GitHub Pages target. It loads committed ES modules through an import map and committed wasm, with no bundler or install step. See [docs/HOST.md](docs/HOST.md).

## Crates

All crates live in the `rust/` workspace (`rust/Cargo.toml`). The engine crates hold mechanics only; the game's rules are Lua in the pack.

| Crate | Path | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sim` | `rust/crates/sim` | The deterministic simulation: Q16.16 fixed point, struct-of-arrays state, movement, combat mechanics, status timers, hashing and persistence. |
| `data` | `rust/crates/data` | The data image generator: evaluates a scenario's `.osd` files into the binary image (format in `rust/crates/data/FORMAT.md`). |
| `mod-host` | `rust/crates/mod-host` | The mod host: the piccolo Lua VM, the natives packs call, and hook dispatch. |
| `oscraft-lsp` | `rust/crates/mod-lsp` | A language server for mods. |
| `mapexport` | `rust/crates/mapexport` | Writes a scenario's map image. |
| `web` | `rust/crates/web` | The wasm build the browser page loads (`js/client/pkg`). |
| `replay` | `rust/crates/replay` | Recording and playback of a sim's order log. |
| `mpq` | `rust/crates/mpq` | MPQ archive reader. |
| `oscraft-relay` | `rust/crates/relay` | Native test relay (NIP-01 over WebSocket) for the browser CI jobs. |
| `oscraft-gate` | `rust/gate` | The check suite that runs against the sim and the packs. |
| `wasip3-guest` | `rust/crates/wasip3` | Excluded from the workspace: the WASI guest that runs the mod host under wasmtime. |

{"path":"scenarios/moba/bottle.lua","content":"local config = require("config")
local bounty = require("bounty")
local protection = require("protection")
local units = require("units")

local TPS = config.TICKS_PER_SECOND

local FULL, EMPTY, BOUNTY = "bottle", "bottle_empty", "bottle_bounty"
local LOAN_FULL, LOAN_EMPTY = "bottle_loan", "bottle_empty_loan"
local FULL_CHARGES = 3
local STORE_TICKS = 120 * TPS
local FOUNTAIN = "fountain"
local USE_REACH_MILLI = 3906 + 234
local AUTOPICKUP_OFF = "bottle_autopickup_off"
local REGEN_UNTIL, REGEN_HP, REGEN_MANA, SLOW = "bottle_regen_until", "bottle_regen_hp", "bottle_regen_mana", "bottle_slow"
local S_MANA_REGEN, S_HEALTH_REGEN, S_SPEED_PCT = 13, 14, 19
local TOGGLE_SECONDS = 10
local WARN_SECONDS = 8
local WARN_TEXT = "Bottled rune will be activated in 20 seconds"
local SLOW_SCAN_EVERY = 4
local BORROW_SCAN_EVERY = 2
local COURIERS = require("courier_kinds").set
local RUNE_ITEM = { "bottle_illusion", "bottle_haste", "bottle_double_damage", "bottle_regeneration", "bottle_invisibility" }
local LOAN_OF = { [FULL] = LOAN_FULL, [EMPTY] = LOAN_EMPTY, [BOUNTY] = BOUNTY .. "_loan" }
for _, name in ipairs(RUNE_ITEM) do LOAN_OF[name] = name .. "_loan" end
local BASE_OF = {}
for base, loan in pairs(LOAN_OF) do BASE_OF[loan] = base end
local HOLDS_RUNE = {}
for base, loan in pairs(LOAN_OF) do
  if base ~= FULL and base ~= EMPTY then
    HOLDS_RUNE[base] = true
    HOLDS_RUNE[loan] = true
  end
end

local stored = {}
local approaching = {}
local use_rune = nil
local capture = nil
local cfg = nil

local bottle = {}

function bottle.on_drink(fn) use_rune = fn end

function bottle.on_capture(fn) capture = fn end

local function settings()
  if cfg == nil then
    local sip_s = config.rule("bottle_sip_s")
    cfg = {
      sip_ticks = sip_s * TPS,
      regen_hp_x100 = math.floor(config.rule("bottle_sip_hp") * 100 / sip_s),
      regen_mana_x100 = math.floor(config.rule("bottle_sip_mana") * 100 / sip_s),
      warn_ticks = config.rule("bottle_warn_s") * TPS,
      slow_pct = config.rule("bottle_slow_pct"),
      share_reach = config.milli(config.rule("bottle_share_reach_milli")),
    }
  end
  return cfg
end

local function is_loan(name) return BASE_OF[name] ~= nil end

local function set_bonus(unit, counter, code, target)
  local previous = game.counter(unit, counter)
  if target ~= previous then
    game.add_stat(unit, code, target - previous)
    game.set_counter(unit, counter, target)
  end
end

local function rows_where(unit, wanted)
  local out = {}
  for _, row in ipairs(game.unit_items(unit)) do
    if wanted(row.name) then out[#out + 1] = row end
  end
  return out
end

local function used_row(list)
  local best = list[1]
  for _, row in ipairs(list) do
    if row.cooldown > best.cooldown then best = row end
  end
  return best
end

local function swap(unit, row, name, count)
  game.cmd_replace_item(unit, row.slot, name, count)
end

local function apply_regen(unit, now)
  local c = settings()
  local running = game.counter(unit, REGEN_UNTIL) > now
  set_bonus(unit, REGEN_HP, S_HEALTH_REGEN, running and c.regen_hp_x100 or 0)
  set_bonus(unit, REGEN_MANA, S_MANA_REGEN, running and c.regen_mana_x100 or 0)
end

local function start_regen(unit, now)
  if game.counter(unit, REGEN_UNTIL) > now then return end
  game.set_counter(unit, REGEN_UNTIL, now + settings().sip_ticks)
  apply_regen(unit, now)
end

local function drink_water(caster, now)
  local list = rows_where(caster, function(name) return name == FULL or name == LOAN_FULL end)
  if #list == 0 then return end
  local row = used_row(list)
  start_regen(caster, now)
  if row.count >= FULL_CHARGES and protection.in_fountain(caster) then return end
  if row.count > 1 then
    game.cmd_set_item_charges(caster, row.slot, row.count - 1)
  else
    swap(caster, row, is_loan(row.name) and LOAN_EMPTY or EMPTY, 1)
  end
end

local function full_form(row)
  return is_loan(row.name) and LOAN_FULL or FULL
end

local function release(unit, row, entry, now)
  swap(unit, row, full_form(row), FULL_CHARGES)
  if use_rune ~= nil then use_rune(unit, entry.power, entry.first, now) end
end

local function drink_rune(caster, now)
  local list = rows_where(caster, function(name) return HOLDS_RUNE[name] end)
  if #list == 0 then return end
  local row = used_row(list)
  local entries = stored[caster] or {}
  for i, entry in ipairs(entries) do
    if entry.item == row.name then
      table.remove(entries, i)
      release(caster, row, entry, now)
      return
    end
  end
  swap(caster, row, full_form(row), FULL_CHARGES)
end

local function emptiest(unit)
  local best, rank = nil, nil
  for _, row in ipairs(game.unit_items(unit)) do
    local drinks = nil
    if row.name == EMPTY or row.name == LOAN_EMPTY then
      drinks = 0
    elseif row.name == FULL or row.name == LOAN_FULL then
      drinks = row.count
    end
    if drinks ~= nil and (best == nil or drinks < rank) then best, rank = row, drinks end
  end
  return best
end

function bottle.store(unit, power, first, now, forced)
  local best = emptiest(unit)
  if best == nil then return false end
  if not forced and game.counter(unit, AUTOPICKUP_OFF) ~= 0 then
    swap(unit, best, full_form(best), FULL_CHARGES)
    return false
  end
  local item = power ~= nil and RUNE_ITEM[power] or BOUNTY
  if is_loan(best.name) then item = LOAN_OF[item] end
  swap(unit, best, item, 1)
  local entries = stored[unit] or {}
  entries[#entries + 1] = { item = item, power = power, first = first, since = now, due = now + STORE_TICKS, warned = false }
  stored[unit] = entries
  return true
end

local function expire_runes(hero, now)
  local entries = stored[hero]
  if entries == nil then return end
  local kept = {}
  for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
    local rows = rows_where(hero, function(name) return name == entry.item end)
    if #rows == 0 then
      if now - entry.since <= 8 then kept[#kept + 1] = entry end
    elseif now >= entry.due and unit_alive(hero) then
      release(hero, rows[1], entry, now)
    else
      if not entry.warned and now >= entry.due - settings().warn_ticks then
        entry.warned = true
        game.message(unit_player(hero), WARN_TEXT, WARN_SECONDS)
      end
      kept[#kept + 1] = entry
    end
  end
  stored[hero] = #kept > 0 and kept or nil
end

local function refill(hero)
  for _, row in ipairs(game.unit_items(hero)) do
    if row.name == EMPTY or row.name == LOAN_EMPTY then
      swap(hero, row, full_form(row), FULL_CHARGES)
    elseif (row.name == FULL or row.name == LOAN_FULL) and row.count < FULL_CHARGES then
      game.cmd_set_item_charges(hero, row.slot, FULL_CHARGES)
    end
  end
end

local function refill_in_fountain(hero)
  if not unit_alive(hero) or not protection.in_fountain(hero) then return end
  refill(hero)
end

local function within_reach(hero, fountain)
  local hx, hy = unit_position(hero)
  local fx, fy = unit_position(fountain)
  local reach = config.milli(USE_REACH_MILLI)
  local dx, dy = hx - fx, hy - fy
  return dx * dx + dy * dy <= reach * reach
end

local function fountain_target(hero, target)
  return game.alive(target) and game.unit_kind(target) == FOUNTAIN and not units.hostile(unit_player(hero), unit_player(target))
end

local function approach(hero, fountain)
  local fx, fy = unit_position(fountain)
  approaching[hero] = fountain
  game.issue_order(hero, 0, fx, fy)
end

local function settle_approach(hero)
  local fountain = approaching[hero]
  if fountain == nil then return end
  if not unit_alive(hero) or not game.alive(fountain) then
    approaching[hero] = nil
  elseif within_reach(hero, fountain) then
    approaching[hero] = nil
    refill(hero)
  end

{"path":"AGENTS.md","content":"# Agent instructions for oscraft

No comments in source: durable facts live here, names carry intent. Pre-comment-sweep Lua rule provenance: git history (`git log --diff-filter=M -S'F_V 14297' -- scenarios/moba/kill_gold.lua`).

## Invariants

- **6.88g wins over every other source.** A 6.88g value is used as is; when 6.88g is silent: analyze (our data, map, script), then web (6.88 changelogs, wiki, map dumps, wc3 modding docs, openwar3), then guess. Each value carries one final label in its file (`6.88g`|`web`|`GUESS`) with its source: war3map.j line, URL, or reasoning. A hero absent from 6.88g takes its Dota 2 entry as `GUESS(web)`. UNVERIFIED is not a final label; an unverified value is a `kind=unverified` provenance row.
- **ENGINE_DEFAULT is the Custom ruleset** (6.88g w3i game_data_setting=0): a value 6.88g leaves to the engine takes the Custom value, not Melee.
- Generator output is never hand-edited: edit the generator.
- Provenance sidecars: comment-free `.osd` sources keep facts in `scenarios/moba/provenance/<source-file-name>.tsv`, columns `anchor<TAB>kind<TAB>note` (kind = provenance|unverified|missing|rationale|source); read with `tools/provenance.mjs`.

## Build, CI, Pages, dev loop

- Game = GitHub Pages site; host in-browser over wireweave (WebRTC + Nostr), no Node game or host. Buildless: committed ES modules and wasm, no bundler.
- `rust/rust-toolchain.toml` pins the compiler for ci.yml, pages.yml, release.yml and local builds (its hash is in the wasm and maps cache keys); bump it there only.
